description: This Java class serves as a command handler for processing withdrawal commands on recurring deposit accounts within the Fineract project. It is annotated with Spring annotations to define its role and transaction management, and it delegates the withdrawal operation to the deposit account service.

classes.name: WithdrawalRecurringDepositAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles withdrawal commands for recurring deposit accounts, delegating the core operation to the DepositAccountWritePlatformService.

methods.name: WithdrawalRecurringDepositAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the DepositAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the withdrawal command by calling the withdrawal method on the deposit account service with the provided command data and deposit account type.
